nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values:
Use image 1 as the primary character reference and preserve the character completely. Keep the exact same identity, face, hairstyle, clothing, pose, body proportions, camera angle, lighting direction, framing, and position within the composition.

Use image 2 only as the new background and environmental reference. Replace the original background from image 1 with the scenery and atmosphere from image 2 while keeping the character untouched.

Blend the character naturally into the new environment with realistic lighting adaptation, matching shadows, color harmony, atmospheric depth, reflections, and environmental interaction. Ensure the character and background feel like they were captured together in the same scene.

Adjust tones, brightness, contrast, ambient light, color temperature, and depth of field so the final image looks seamless and photorealistic. Preserve realistic perspective and spatial consistency between foreground and background.

Do not alter or regenerate the character. Do not change the character’s scale, position, proportions, or composition relative to the original image. Preserve the original image aspect ratio.

Ultra realistic, cinematic photography, natural color grading, realistic shadows, immersive atmosphere, photorealistic textures, high detail, seamless compositing, visually coherent scene, 4K, ultra detailed.

inputs.text: A medium close-up shot features a Caucasian man with a closely shaven head and face, wearing a black baseball cap with "PNTR" in white letters on the front, and a dark grey t-shirt with "JUST DO IT" visible across his chest. A small black microphone is clipped to his shirt collar. He is positioned slightly to the left of the frame, looking intently downwards and to his right, his eyes focused off-camera. His facial expression is one of deep concentration, with his brow slightly furrowed. As he looks down, a quick sniff sound is heard, and then he speaks with a deep male voice and a slightly frustrated tone, saying, "I think it's so bad." The camera remains static throughout, maintaining a shallow depth of field, which keeps the man in sharp focus while the background is softly blurred, revealing a light-colored wall with white wooden shelving or trim, and a partially open white wooden door on the right. After a brief pause, another short, audible sniff is heard. The man then continues to speak, his voice maintaining the same quality, as he states, "So bad. So bad." He elaborates further, emphasizing his point with a final statement, "This got to be, it's got to be the worst tool I've ever seen."
